title: DEV: Fix flaky admin site texts theme filter spec
body:
Fixes the flaky `Admin Site Texts Page can filter, edit, and revert a component translation in the selected language` ([failed run](https://github.com/discourse/discourse/actions/runs/35987977309)).

`select_theme` called `SelectKit#collapse` after picking a row, but the combo-box already closes itself on change, so `collapse` re-opened it with a click on the header's center. The theme selector is clearable, and with a short enough selected name the "×" sits at that center, so the click cleared the theme instead and the wait for the expanded dropdown timed out. Whether it hits depends on the fabricated name/id length, hence order-dependent flakiness (deterministic locally when run alone).

Now waits for the selected value instead of collapsing. Focused spec: 3/3 failing before, 5/5 passing after.

Related: https://patch.discourse.org/patch-triage/2663
